name: Braised fish
summary: Braised fish served at a Jrai guest meal by the Ba river, beside stir-fried cassava leaf and yellow ant salt.
origin: The cassava-leaf article’s closing meal is lá mì xào, cá um, and muối kiến vàng, in a small stilt house by the Ba river.
howToEat: Eat it with stir-fried cassava leaf and yellow ant salt, the way it is served at a Jrai guest meal.
where: A small Jrai stilt house by the Ba river.
seoDescription: Cá um is braised fish, served with stir-fried cassava leaf and yellow ant salt at a Jrai guest meal by the Ba river.
